acquisition_method.evidence: Eluting peptides were analyzed in the mass spectrometer using data depend acquisition (DDA) mode.
experiment types: Gel-based experiment; Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins (30 µg) were run for 4 cm into an SDS-PAGE and 8 pieces (a 0.5 cm height) were cut out and digested using trypsin according to Shevchenko et al. (Shevchenko, Andrej, et al. "In-gel digestion for mass spectrometric characterization of proteins and proteomes." Nature protocols 1.6 (2006): 2856.) adapted to on a DigestPro MSi robotic system (INTAVIS Bioanalytical Instruments AG).

collision_energy.evidence: Peptide features were isolated with a window of 1.4 m/z, fragmented using 26% NCE.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Peptide features were isolated with a window of 1.4 m/z, fragmented using 26% NCE.

instrument.evidence: A LC-MS/MS analysis was carried out on an Ultimate 3000 UPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific) directly connected to an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer for a total of 60 min.
